title: Termwise derived pullback of a bounded above flat complex
statement:
Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes and let $E$ be a bounded above
complex of flat $\mathcal{O}_S$-modules. Then the derived pullback
$Lg^*E$ of [def-pc-derived-pullback] is represented by the complex
$g^*E$ obtained by pulling $E$ back term by term: the canonical map
$g^*E\to Lg^*E$ is a quasi-isomorphism.

proof.text: The bounded-above flat complex $E$ is K-flat over $\mathcal O_S$ by [lem-pc-bounded-above-flat-kflat].

Since $E$ is K-flat (Step 1), the identity $E\to E$ is a K-flat resolution of $E$, so [def-pc-derived-pullback] applied with $\mathcal P^\bullet=E$ gives $Lg^*E\cong g^*E=\mathcal O_T\otimes_{g^{-1}\mathcal O_S}g^{-1}E$, the termwise pullback, canonically in $D(\mathcal O_T)$. This canonical identification is the comparison map $g^*E\to Lg^*E$, which is therefore an isomorphism in $D(\mathcal O_T)$, i.e. a quasi-isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem flatComplexDerivedPullback {T S : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))] (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) (hbounded : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → IsZero (K.X i)) (hflat : ∀ i : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlat (K.X i)) : ∃ (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) (hF : ∀ M, F.obj M = Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj g M) (_ : ∀ {M N} (a : M ⟶ N), F.map a = eqToHom (hF M) ≫ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackMap g a ≫ eqToHom (hF N).symm) (_ : F.Additive) (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback g ⟶ F.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh), (derivedPullback g).IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ∧ ∃ e : DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≅ (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K)), e.inv = ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K)
lean.note: Termwise tensor pullback on the shared module-sheaf carrier is pinned on objects and maps. The ordinary-to-derived comparison is the isomorphism e whose inverse is the canonical left-derived counit epsilon at K; the universal property is stated, so the comparison is not an arbitrary isomorphism.

reviewed_lean.note: g:T->S arbitrary scheme morphism; K a Z-graded complex on the shared moduleRings carrier of derivedPullback; bounded-above and termwise SheafOfModules.IsFlat verbatim as isKFlat_of_boundedAbove_flat; F pinned to tensorPullbackObj/Map exactly as exists_derivedPullback; eps is a left-derived counit of the recorded derivedPullback g (unique up to automorphism, so the exists e with e.inv = eps.app K amounts to IsIso of the canonical comparison at K, direction g*E -> Lg*E); no second derived pullback, no let, HasDerivedCategory.{w} binders as siblings; stmt_dep def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules landed
